title: Moazi
tagline: plugs into PREP and have swarm of AI agents ,  all providing feedback in real time,
description: Moazi - Multi-Agent with autonomous AI agents that analyze market conditions and generate trading intents for GMX perpetual futures..  Agents stream “intents,” a Lit PKP (Vincent) signs only within user guard-rails,, and everything is persisted in Convex with a full audit trail. Users choose Copilot or Autopilot, set policies, and can kill-switch at any time.....
how_its_made:
## 🏗️ Architecture

### Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Convex (real-time database + serverless functions)
- **Auth**: Clerk
- **Trading**: GMX V2 API integration
- **AI**: LangChain + OpenAI for agent logic

### Key Components
- **Multi-Agent System**: Liquidity Agent 🌊 + Funding Agent 💰
- **Intent Stream**: Real-time trading signal generation
- **Trading Dashboard**: Live positions, P&L, market data
- **Wallet Integration**: Vincent + RainbowKit



## 🔧 Key Features

1. **Autonomous Intent Generation**: Agents analyze 8 trading pairs every minute
2. **Real-time Updates**: Live price feeds, position tracking, P&L
3. **Multi-Agent Coordination**: Agents work in rotation across different pairs
4. **Modular Architecture**: Easy to add new agents
5. **Risk Management**: Position sizing based on confidence levels
